statement.en: Sociative derivation in Ainu involves no valency change, has no dedicated marker, and is commonly expressed by the reciprocal u- combined with the applicative ko- (functioning together as a single morpheme uko-, or less frequently ue-).
statement.ja: アイヌ語の共同（sociative）派生は価項変化を伴わず、専用の標識を持たず、相互接頭辞 u- と適用接頭辞 ko- の組み合わせ（単一の形態素 uko-、まれに ue- として機能する）によって一般に表される。

entailment.quote: Sociative derivation does not involve any valency change and has no specialized marker. It is commonly expressed by the reciprocal u- + polysemous applicative ko-... the combined prefix uko- (less frequently ue-) functions as a single socia

anchor.exact: uko- is also productive as a marker of object-oriented reciprocals, e.g. ninu 'sew sth' (vt) (T 419) → uko-ninu 'sew sth (two or more things) together' (vt) (T 759).

statement.en: The combination uko- is productive as a marker of object-oriented reciprocals.
statement.ja: uko- は目的語指向の相互標識としても生産的である。

entailment.quote: uko- is also productive as a marker of object-oriented reciprocals

anchor.exact: Another means of expressing sociative meaning is reciprocal u- in combination with causative -re/-e/-te (less commonly -ka), e.g. mina 'laugh' (vi) → u-mina-re 'laugh together' (vi) (OI).

statement.en: Sociative meaning can also be expressed by combining the reciprocal prefix u- with the causative suffix -re/-e/-te (or less commonly -ka).
statement.ja: 共同の意味は、相互接頭辞 u- と使役接尾辞 -re/-e/-te（まれに -ka）の組み合わせによっても表される。

entailment.quote: Another means of expressing sociative meaning is reciprocal u- in combination with causative -re/-e/-te (less commonly -ka)

anchor.exact: The reciprocal prefix combines with certain nouns as a marker of the dual number, e.g. u-tek 'both hands'. It is also used to denote family relations on both nouns and verbs, cf. ona 'father' → u-ona-kor 'to be (related as) father and child'. There are reciprocal forms from relational nouns and postpositions

statement.en: The reciprocal prefix u- combines with certain nouns as a marker of dual number, denotes family relations on nouns and verbs, and forms reciprocal stems from relational nouns and postpositions.
statement.ja: 相互接頭辞 u- は特定の特定名詞と結合して双数標識として機能し、名詞および動詞上で家族関係を表し、位置名詞や後置詞から相互形を形成する。

entailment.quote: The reciprocal prefix combines with certain nouns as a marker of the dual number... It is also used to denote family relations on both nouns and verbs... There are reciprocal forms from relational nouns and postpositions

anchor.exact: I suggest that yay- has a major reflexive function and also a number of other functions usually expressed by reflexive markers in other languages (Geniušienė 1987): reflexive-possessive, e.g. ko-yupu 'fasten sth to sth/sb' (vb) → yay-ko-yupu <REFL-to.APPL-fasten> 'fasten sth to oneself' (vt) (AB 47), autocausative, e.g. osura 'throw sth/sb' → yay-osura 'throw oneself' (NV 93), and, occasionally, anticausative functions

statement.en: The prefix yay- has a primary reflexive function along with reflexive-possessive, autocausative, and occasionally anticausative functions.
statement.ja: 接頭辞 yay- は主要な再帰機能に加えて、再帰所有、自己使役（autocausative）、そして時には反使役（anticausative）の機能を持つ。

entailment.quote: yay- has a major reflexive function and also a number of other functions... reflexive-possessive... autocausative... and, occasionally, anticausative functions

anchor.exact: si- has a major anticausative function (original O turns into S), implied by its traditional interpretation as middle/unintentional reflexive. However, it may also be used productively as autocausative, e.g. etaye 'pull sth' (vt) → si-etaye <REFL-pull> 'pull oneself in (go back inside)' (vi) (AB 47), and reflexive-causative. It may also mark reflexivity on relational nouns

statement.en: The prefix si- has a primary anticausative function, but can also be used productively as an autocausative, as a reflexive-causative, and to mark reflexivity on relational nouns.
statement.ja: 接頭辞 si- は主要な反使役機能を持つが、自己使役、再帰使役、また位置名詞における再帰性の標識としても生産的に用いられる。

entailment.quote: si- has a major anticausative function... However, it may also be used productively as autocausative... and reflexive-causative. It may also mark reflexivity on relational nouns.

anchor.exact: The "intransitive suffix" -ke (Table 15.4, slot V)32 may also be regarded as an anticausative marker (although a much more lexical one than si-). There is an alternation between anticausative -ke and causative -V on bound stems such as yas- in (57a).

statement.en: The intransitive suffix -ke functions as an anticausative marker, alternating with the causative suffix -V on bound stems.
statement.ja: 自動詞接尾辞 -ke は反使役標識として機能し、拘束語幹において使役接尾辞 -V と交替する。

entailment.quote: The 'intransitive suffix' -ke ... may also be regarded as an anticausative marker... There is an alternation between anticausative -ke and causative -V on bound stems.

anchor.exact: most nouns in Ainu cannot appear in locative phrases without or(-o) ‘the place (of)’, etc., so or-o is retained in its possessive form within the relative clause together with locative postposition

statement.en: When relativizing an oblique location, most nouns retain the relational noun or(-o) in its possessive form together with the locative postposition inside the relative clause.
statement.ja: 斜格の位置を関係節化する際、大部分の名詞は関係節内において所属形の位置名詞or(-o)を格後置詞とともに保持する。

conditions: with nouns that cannot appear in locative phrases without relational nouns

entailment.quote: most nouns in Ainu cannot appear in locative phrases without or(-o) ... so or-o is retained in its possessive form within the relative clause together with locative postposition.

anchor.exact: relativization of the possessor (only inalienable). Possessee is retained in possessive form, highlighting the possessor’s presence.

statement.en: Possessor relativization is restricted to inalienable possessors, and the possessed noun is retained in its possessive form within the relative clause.
statement.ja: 所有者の関係節化は不可譲渡的所有者に限られ、被所有名詞は所属形のまま関係節内に保持される。

entailment.quote: relativization of the possessor (only inalienable). Possessee is retained in possessive form.

anchor.exact: Bound nouns (15.3.1) are the most common heads of relative clauses

statement.en: Bound nouns are the most frequent heads of relative clauses.
statement.ja: 結合名詞（形式名詞）は関係節の主要部として最も一般的である。

entailment.quote: Bound nouns (15.3.1) are the most common heads of relative clauses.

anchor.exact: One other interesting type of noun-modifying construction²⁵ occurs, which cannot be subsumed under the traditional relative clause because there is no possible non-relative paraphrase in which the head noun can appear as an argument or adjunct

statement.en: Ainu possesses a noun-modifying construction equivalent to the Japanese 'soto no kankei' type, in which the head noun cannot appear as an argument or adjunct in a corresponding non-relative clause.
statement.ja: アイヌ語には、主要部名詞が非関係節において項や付加詞として現れ得ない、日本語の「外の関係」に相当する名詞修飾構文が存在する。

entailment.quote: One other interesting type of noun-modifying construction... which cannot be subsumed under the traditional relative clause because there is no possible non-relative paraphrase in which the head noun can appear as an argument or adjunct...

statement.ja: 福田（田村）(1955)によれば、沙流方言の動詞構造には6つのスロットが存在する：(I) 適用補語e-/ko-/o-、(II) 相互u-・再帰yay-/si-・総称目的語i-、(III) 重ねられる適用補語e-/ko-/o-、(IV) 単複接尾辞、(V) 他動・自動接尾辞、(VI) 使役-re/-e/-teおよび-yar(/-ar)。

anchor.exact: account for the possibility of noun incorporation: right before the base (0) and before each applicative slot (I/III).

statement.en: Noun incorporation in the verb template can occur right before the base (slot 0) and before each applicative slot (slots I and III).
statement.ja: 動詞テンプレートにおける名詞抱合は、語幹基部（スロット0）の直前および各適用補語スロット（スロットI・III）の直前に生じうる。

entailment.quote: noun incorporation: right before the base (0) and before each applicative slot (I/III).

anchor.exact: there are two devices for increasing valency (applicative e-, ko-, o- and causative²⁷ -e/-te/-re, -ka, -ke, -V) and five for decreasing valency (reflexive yay-, si-, reciprocal u-, antipassive i-, anticausative si-, -ke, and noun incorporation).

statement.en: Ainu has two devices for increasing verbal valency (applicatives and causatives) and five devices for decreasing valency (reflexive, reciprocal, antipassive, anticausative, and noun incorporation).
statement.ja: アイヌ語には価を増大させる2つの手段（適用補語および使役）と、価を減少させる5つの手段（再帰、相互、逆使役［反受動］、反使役、および名詞抱合）がある。

entailment.quote: there are two devices for increasing valency (applicative e-, ko-, o- and causative... ) and five for decreasing valency (reflexive yay-, si-, reciprocal u-, antipassive i-, anticausative si-, -ke, and noun incorporation)

anchor.exact: no verb has been found to contain all six kinds of affix and noun incorporation

statement.en: No single verb in Ainu has been found to instantiate all six voice-marking affix slots simultaneously along with noun incorporation.
statement.ja: 6種類の接辞すべてと名詞抱合を同時に含む動詞形はアイヌ語において1つも見出されていない。

entailment.quote: Although no verb has been found to contain all six kinds of affix and noun incorporation

anchor.exact: Ainu applicatives are derived with e-/ko-/o-. These prefixes increase valency, but their specific semantic function may vary.

statement.en: Ainu applicatives are derived using the prefixes e-, ko-, and o-, which increase verbal valency across a range of semantic roles.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の適用補語接頭辞e-、ko-、o-は動詞の価を増大させ、多様な意味役割を標示する。

entailment.quote: Ainu applicatives are derived with e-/ko-/o-. These prefixes increase valency

anchor.exact: In Bugaeva (2010a), the three applicatives are defined as instrumental e-, dative ko-, and locative o- because most other roles can be explained in terms of their relatedness to the proto-role.

statement.en: Bugaeva (2010a) analyzes the three applicative prefixes e-, ko-, and o- prototypically as instrumental e-, dative ko-, and locative o-.
statement.ja: Bugaeva (2010a)は3つの適用補語接頭辞を、原型的な役割に基づき具格e-、与格ko-、場所格o-と定義している。

entailment.quote: In Bugaeva (2010a), the three applicatives are defined as instrumental e-, dative ko-, and locative o-

anchor.exact: The prefixes turn intransitive verbs into bivalent transitives. The S-affix =an of the base construction (43a) is replaced by its A-counterpart a= in (43b), and the ta-marked adjunct is promoted to object.

statement.en: When an applicative prefix attaches to an intransitive verb, the verb becomes a bivalent transitive, shifting intransitive subject agreement (e.g. =an) to transitive agent agreement (e.g. a=) and promoting an oblique adjunct to object.
statement.ja: 適用補語接頭辞が自動詞に付加されると2価の他動詞になり、主語標識（例：=an）が他動詞主語標識（例：a=）に交代して、付加詞が目的語へと昇格する。

entailment.quote: The prefixes turn intransitive verbs into bivalent transitives. The S-affix =an of the base construction (43a) is replaced by its A-counterpart a= in (43b), and the ta-marked adjunct is promoted to object.

anchor.exact: Applicativized bivalent transitives turn into trivalent transitives (44b), which have two unmarked objects that are rather similar in terms of encoding and behavioral properties.

statement.en: Applicativized bivalent transitive verbs become trivalent transitives possessing two unmarked objects with similar coding and behavioral properties.
statement.ja: 2価の他動詞に適用補語が付加されると3価の他動詞となり、形態的標示および統語的振る舞いが類似した2つの無標識の目的語をとる。

entailment.quote: Applicativized bivalent transitives turn into trivalent transitives (44b), which have two unmarked objects that are rather similar in terms of encoding and behavioral properties.

anchor.exact: In principle, either object can be cross-referenced on the verb (one at a time) if first/second person. In practice, it is usually Recipient objects that are cross-referenced because they are typically animate and may have first/second person referents

statement.en: In trivalent applicative clauses, while either object can in principle be cross-referenced if first or second person, in practice Recipient objects are usually cross-referenced because they are typically animate.
statement.ja: 3価の適用補語節では、1・2人称であれば原理的にどちらの目的語も動詞に人称標示されうるが、実際には典型的には有生である受取手目的語が人称標示されるのが通例である。

conditions: with first- or second-person object referents

anchor.exact: a great deal of Ainu applicatives deviate considerably from the prototype lacking non-applicative paraphrases (e- applicatives (Content, Theme) and ko- (Recipient)) or adding a participant with a Theme role (e- applicatives) or both

statement.en: Many Ainu applicative constructions deviate from the cross-linguistic prototype by lacking non-applicative paraphrases or by adding a participant with a Theme role.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の多くの適用補語構文は、非適用補語の言い換えが存在しないか、あるいは主題役割を持つ参与者を追加する（またはその両方）という点で、通言語的な典型から著しく逸脱している。

entailment.quote: a great deal of Ainu applicatives deviate considerably from the prototype lacking non-applicative paraphrases ... or adding a participant with a Theme role ... or both

anchor.exact: The thematic applicative (45b) is very unusual cross-linguistically and I suggest that it originated in the instrumental applicative and was based on the three-argument schema.

statement.en: Thematic applicatives in Ainu are proposed to have originated from the instrumental applicative based on a three-argument schema.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の主題適用補語は、3項スキーマに基づく具格適用補語に起源を持つと考えられる。

entailment.quote: I suggest that it originated in the instrumental applicative and was based on the three-argument schema.

anchor.exact: most thematic applicatives involve derived intransitive bases containing either noun incorporation or valency-decreasing antipassive i-/anticausative si-, which are often fossilized as in ikka 'steal'

statement.en: Most thematic applicatives are formed on derived intransitive bases containing either noun incorporation or valency-decreasing morphology (antipassive i- or anticausative si-).
statement.ja: ほとんどの主題適用補語は、名詞抱合または価を減少させる形態素（逆使役i-または反使役si-）を含む派生自動詞語幹に基づいている。

entailment.quote: most thematic applicatives involve derived intransitive bases containing either noun incorporation or valency-decreasing antipassive i-/anticausative si-

statement.en: The dative postposition eun is rarely found in texts marking recipients or addressees when a corresponding ko- applicative exists, occurring predominantly with the few verbs that lack such applicatives.
statement.ja: 与格後置詞eunは対応するko-適用補語が存在する場合にはテキスト中滅多に現れず、そのような適用補語を持たない少数の動詞とともに主として用いられる。

entailment.quote: the frequency of eun-marked constructions in texts is rather low as it is preferably used with those few verbs for which there are, for some reason, no corresponding Recipient/Addressee applicatives

statement.en: When a recipient is pronominal, the eun-marked non-applicative paraphrase does not occur in texts if a corresponding ko- applicative exists.
statement.ja: 対応するko-適用補語が存在する場合、受取手が代名詞的項であるときにはeun標識による非適用補語の言い換え構文はテキスト中に出現しない。

entailment.quote: no chance if Recipient is encoded by a pronominal argument

anchor.exact: O-incorporation is by far the most common type in Ainu and cross-linguistically, leading to a decrease of valency by one

statement.en: O-incorporation is by far the most common type of noun incorporation in Ainu and cross-linguistically, leading to a decrease of valency by one.
statement.ja: 目的語抱合はアイヌ語および通言語的に群を抜いて最も一般的なタイプであり、結合価を1つ減少させる。

entailment.quote: O-incorporation is by far the most common type in Ainu and cross-linguistically, leading to a decrease of valency by one

statement.en: A-incorporation results in valency decrease, removing the original A from argument position while the original O is promoted to S.
statement.ja: 動作主抱合（A抱合）も結合価の減少をもたらし、元のAが項位置から除去される一方で、元のOがSへと昇格する。

entailment.quote: A-incorporation (59) also results in valency decrease: the original A is removed from an argument position by incorporation, while the original O promotes to S.

statement.en: S-incorporation may either decrease valency by one and yield a zero-argument verb, or rearrange valency by introducing a new S argument when a noun (usually a body part or relational noun) is incorporated in its possessive form.
statement.ja: 主語抱合（S抱合）は、結合価を1つ減らして0項動詞をもたらすか、あるいは名詞（通常は身体部位や関係名詞）が所属形で抱合される場合に新たなS項を導入して結合価を再編する。

anchor.exact: O-Incorporation is very common with applicative verbs in which it may not only apply to base objects of transitives (62), but also to applicative objects of base bivalent (63a) and trivalent (64a) transitives

statement.en: O-incorporation is very common with applicative verbs, applying to base transitive objects as well as applicative objects of base bivalent and trivalent transitives.
statement.ja: 目的語抱合は適用態動詞において極めて一般的であり、他動詞の基本目的語のみならず、基底の2価・3価他動詞の適用態目的語にも適用される。

statement.en: In a trivalent causative verb, either the causee or the original object can be incorporated.
statement.ja: 3価の使役動詞では、被使役者または元の目的語のいずれかを抱合することができる。

entailment.quote: One of the objects, either the causee (65a) or original object (65b), can be incorporated in the case of a trivalent causative verb.

anchor.exact: In the case of trivalent causative-applicatives such as sik 'be full' (vi) → e-sik 'be full of sth' (vt) → e-sik-te 'fill sth with sb' (vd), there are examples of incorporation of both objects with slight lexicalization.

statement.en: In trivalent causative-applicatives, both objects can be incorporated, accompanied by slight lexicalization.
statement.ja: 3価の使役適用態動詞では、わずかな語彙化を伴って両方の目的語が抱合される例が存在する。

entailment.quote: In the case of trivalent causative-applicatives such as sik 'be full' (vi) → e-sik 'be full of sth' (vt) → e-sik-te 'fill sth with sb' (vd), there are examples of incorporation of both objects with slight lexicalization.

anchor.exact: There is only one general restriction on O-incorporation: objects which are animate, specific, and referential at the same time cannot be incorporated.

statement.ja: 有生性・特定性・指示性を同時に備える目的語は、目的語抱合を受けることができない。

entailment.quote: objects which are animate, specific, and referential at the same time cannot be incorporated.

anchor.exact: we never find incorporated causee objects in the case of indirect causatives (both (65a) and (66) are direct causatives) and any applicative objects with the Recipient/Beneficiary role.

entailment.quote: we never find incorporated causee objects in the case of indirect causatives (both (65a) and (66) are direct causatives) and any applicative objects with the Recipient/Beneficiary role.

anchor.exact: O-incorporation is frequent in Ainu (S/A-incorporation is rare), especially in oral literature.

statement.ja: アイヌ語において目的語抱合は頻繁に見られるが、S抱合およびA抱合は稀である。

entailment.quote: O-incorporation is frequent in Ainu (S/A-incorporation is rare), especially in oral literature.

statement.en: With base bivalent transitives, O-incorporation is most common with verbs of Pursuit/Affected Subject/Perception/Cognition and Interaction.
statement.ja: 基底の2価他動詞において、目的語抱合は「追跡/被影響主語/知覚/認識」および「相互行為」を表す動詞で最も一般的である。

entailment.quote: In the case of base bivalent transitives, O-incorporation is most common with verbs of Pursuit/Affected Subject/Perception/Cognition and Interaction (Bugaeva, forthcoming b), just like antipassives.

anchor.exact: Trivalent transitive verbs do not align themselves as a separate class because all of them are derived verbs.

statement.ja: アイヌ語の3価他動詞は、すべて派生動詞であるため、独立した結合価クラスを構成しない。

entailment.quote: Trivalent transitive verbs do not align themselves as a separate class because all of them are derived verbs.

anchor.exact: Ainu verbs may be marked for aspect, modality, and evidentiality, but there are no pure tense markers.

statement.en: Ainu verbs have no pure tense markers.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の動詞には純粋な時制標識が存在しない。

statement.en: In the speech of the last Ainu speakers, Japanese contact effects led to an increased reliance on postpositions and a decline in the use of applicatives.
statement.ja: 最後のアイヌ語話者の言語において、日本語との接触の影響により後置詞の使用が増加し、適用態の使用が衰退した。

statement.en: The last Ainu speakers adopted the benefactive pair verb construction wa kore (modelled on Japanese -te kureru) in place of ko-applicatives.
